📦 **sirius-home-menu-core `2b5a69f`** — feat(town): split consumed meals and ingredients and show home kitchen menu

Resolve existing home meal IDs through homeMenu metadata for cooked names/icons. Add separate actual ingredient section with clear legacy-data message, preserve service meal rows, and expose22-entry home kitchen menu with per100 inputs. Mark extra-meal inclusion in proportions. Existing economics remain host-owned.

Actual townDay fixture, full tuiSumHTML browser preview, menu expansion and legacy record tested. Four scenarios14 days match baseline economic state/reports; actual ingredient totals verified separately. Build --code source/AST checks pass with26 ship files unchanged.

Refs TASK-1005

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
